description: Guild Created in February 2023 during a merger with Flex Gang & Black Past, which will become French Legacy & French Legacy 2 & French Legacy 3, and yes there are currently 3 guilds!
body:
# 🌟 FrenchLegacy: The Ultimate Hypixel SkyBlock Modpack (1.21.* & 26.*)

**FrenchLegacy** is a next-generation, lightweight **Fabric modpack** meticulously optimized for **Hypixel SkyBlock**. By combining cutting-edge performance engines with the absolute best community tools, this pack delivers maximum FPS, flawless interface enhancements, and unmatched in-game data tracking.

![hypixel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f54f8b74f5321de9aed0d24b418c13e65f9e741_0.webp)

---

### ⚡ Why choose FrenchLegacy?
* 🚀 **Extreme FPS Boosts** — Powered by Sodium and modern multi-threading optimizations.
* 🔮 **Advanced Solvers & Overlays** — Crushes Dungeons, Slayers, and Garden farming effortlessly.
* 💎 **Sleek & Clean UI** — Say goodbye to cluttered screens and text-heavy menus.
* 🛠️ **Crash-Proof Design** — Built to keep you in the game, even if a minor mod error occurs.

---

# ✨ Core Features

<details>
<summary>⚔️ SkyBlock Enhancements & Solvers</summary>

* **SkyHanni** — The gold standard for QoL. Includes custom alerts, localized event timers, automated farming overlays, and detailed slayer trackers.
* **Skyblocker** — A sleek, modern open-source Fabric mod packed with high-end puzzle solvers and customizable UI elements.
* **SkyblockAddons (SBA)** — The legendary classic. Features item-locking protection, custom health/mana bars, and crucial danger warnings.
* **SecretRoutes** — Your ultimate Dungeons guide. Displays the fastest routes and locations for secrets directly in the Catacombs.
* **Odin** — A highly efficient utility mod providing specialized macro-free solvers, customizable triggers, and performance-friendly tweaks.
* **SBO (Skyblock Overhaul)** — Tailored helpers for major world events, Mayor perks tracking, and mythological Diana ritual paths.
* **SkyBlockPv** — Adds real-time combat stats, DPS meters, and utility overlays to optimize your gear setups.
* **Athen & Devonian** — Powerful background utility packages designed for progressive goal tracking and analytical game data extraction.
* **HypixelModAPI** — Full official API integration, ensuring legal, safe, and lightning-fast data syncing with the network.
* **HypixelAutoTip** — Background network tipping tool to passively maximize your network experience and Arcade coins.

</details>

---

<details>
<summary>🚀 Next-Gen Performance Engines</summary>

* **Sodium** ⚡ — The revolutionary rendering engine that replaces standard Minecraft graphics code to double or triple your framerate.
* **Lithium** ⚡ — Optimizes standard game physics, chunk loading, and internal logic without altering vanilla mechanics.
* **ImmediatelyFast** 🖥️ — Strips away UI rendering lag, heavily optimizing text, nameplates, and HUD overlays.
* **MoreCulling & EntityCulling** 🎮 — Drastically reduces GPU load by hiding entities and tile-entities you cannot physically see.
* **BadOptimizations** 🧠 — Cleverly bypasses micro-stutters and standard memory bottlenecks inherent to modern Minecraft versions.
* **VMP** 👥 — Drastically scales down multiplayer lag, keeping your client smooth even in packed lobbies or hub servers.
* **AsyncParticles** 💨 — Offloads combat and potion particles to secondary CPU cores to prevent frame drops during intense dungeon boss fights.

</details>

---

<details>
<summary>🖥️ UI, Quality of Life & Chat Management</summary>

* **Roughly Enough Items (REI)** 📖 — Your in-game encyclopedia. Quickly search through items, crafts, and custom recipes straight from your inventory.
* **ModernWarpMenu** 🗺️ — Replaces tedious chat commands like `/warp dungeon` with a beautiful, clickable graphical world map.
* **Enhanced Chat & Chat Tabs** 📂 — Fully reorganizes and filters your chat logs. Easily split party, guild, and local chat into clean channels.
* **GuildZip** ✂️ — Automatically compresses long, repetitive guild chat strings to keep your interface clean.
* **Sound Controller** 🔊 — Total mastery over audio paths. Adjust, mute, or amplify specific sound groups effortlessly.
* **NotEnoughCrashes** 🛠️ — A literal lifesaver. If a mod encounters an error, it prevents the game from closing, allowing you to return straight to the main menu without relaunching.

</details>

---

## 🔮 Future Updates
We are committed to long-term support. As soon as a new Minecraft version drops or critical Hypixel updates are released, **future versions of this modpack will be updated and pushed as fast as humanly possible!** Stay tuned for swift releases and day-one support.

## 💡 Important Performance Note
To guarantee maximum frame rates straight out of the box, graphic-intensive modules like **Iris Shaders** are marked as `.disabled` by default. If your rig can handle it and you want to use custom shaders, you can easily toggle them back on via your Modrinth instance/mod menu settings!
